action: Update CODESYS Automation Server Connector and CODESYS Service Tool to 1.40.0.0 or later. Read CERT@VDE advisories VDE-2026-145 and VDE-2026-146 linked from the Cyber Centre notice for the flaw details.
exec: Industrial automation engineering tools from CODESYS need updating; the Canadian advisory reports no exploitation.
plain: Canada's cyber agency told users of CODESYS industrial automation software that two of its tools have security flaws fixed in version 1.40.0.0.

key_findings: Affected: CODESYS Automation Server Connector before 1.40.0.0 and CODESYS Service Tool before 1.40.0.0.
Linked advisory VDE-2026-145 covers multiple vulnerabilities in both products.
Linked advisory VDE-2026-146 covers a path traversal in the Automation Server Connector.
The page names no CVE identifiers and makes no statement about exploitation.
recommendations: Review the two CERT@VDE advisories and the CODESYS security advisories page linked from the advisory.
Apply the necessary updates as they become available.

summary: Cyber Centre control systems advisory AV26-1169 covers vulnerabilities in CODESYS Automation Server Connector and CODESYS Service Tool before version 1.40.0.0. It links to two CERT@VDE advisories: VDE-2026-145 on multiple flaws in both products and VDE-2026-146 on a path traversal in the Automation Server Connector. No CVEs are named on the page and exploitation is not mentioned.
title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security issues control systems advisory AV26-1169 on CODESYS tools

validation.note: Reviewed against the original Canadian Centre for Cyber Security document.
